messages:
Jordana: Heads-up — planning a region routing policy shift for EU->APAC edge pools tonight during the 22:00 UTC window. Goal: move APAC-bound traffic from eu-edge-1 to eu-edge-2 to balance HW utilization. Looking for deploy owner + smoke check volunteers.

Kevin: I can own the deploy. Will coordinate with infra on the DNS TTL change.

Li: What rollout curve are we thinking? Canary percentages and timing?

Jordana: Proposed: 5% -> 30m -> 25% -> 30m -> 70% -> 30m -> 100%. If any step fails health checks, immediate rollback to previous weights.

Ana: For clarity — TTL will be lowered to 60s 10 minutes before first cut, right?

Samir: Yes. I’ll push TTL change (route53) at T-10. Will also post confirmation.

Kevin: Plan for smoke checks: simple 200s /health from multiple APAC vantage points + tail latency from p50/p95 services behind edge. If any 5xx or p95 spike > 2x baseline, abort.

Ana: PromQL snippets for the smoke run: 
```
# error rate across edge pool
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="edge-proxy",code=~"5.."}[5m]))

# p95 latency for router
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="router"}[5m])) by (le))
```

Li: Can we add a quick synthetic curl test that checks kv-cache warm paths? Something like: 
```
curl -s -D - https://api.redwood.local/edge/health -H 'Host: test-apac' | head -n 20
```
Will run from apac-ci runners at each stage.

Jordana: Good. Also add a trace sampling check: ensure trace spans show endpoint switching to eu-edge-2. Samir — can you validate sampling config?

Samir: Sampling looks good. I’ll tail traces via jaeger with a quick match on new host header.

ops-bot: deploy window reserved: 2026-03-18 22:00 UTC -> 22:45 UTC. Reminder: runbook v3 at /runbooks/edge-routing-shift.

Kevin: I'll be oncall during the window. @Ana will you monitor dashboards? @Li can you run the synthetic runners?

Ana: Yep, dashboard watch. I’ll create a small dashboard row with the PromQL and cloudwatch health checks.

Li: Synthetic runners ready. I’ll post outputs to thread at each step.

Jordana: Rollback playbook summary: 1) revert weighted DNS record using traffic manager -> set weights back, 2) restore TTL to previous, 3) rollback any config toggles in router-service via canary flag, 4) alert oncall. Keep rollback script ready: 
```
# Terraform-ish pseudo
module "traffic" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infra/traffic.git//modules/weighted"
  env = "prod"
  weights = { eu-edge-1 = 90, eu-edge-2 = 10 }
}
```

Kevin: Noted. I’ll stage the revert in the traffic repo so it’s a single PR we can merge if abort.

Ana: One more request — can we ensure error budget alerting is muted for the window so noisy alerts don't wake folks? Will unmute on finish.

Jordana: Good call. Samir, please mute platform-alerts:edge-traffic for the 45m window.

Samir: Done. I’ll annotate the alert with the run id and re-enable at T+50.

ops-bot: checklist complete: TTL change, runbook link, deploy owner assigned, rollback PR pre-created (draft).

Li: Quick Q — are there any services pinned to eu-edge-1 that need special handling? I remember auth had a static endpoint earlier.

Jordana: Good catch. Auth team confirmed they accept requests from both edges. I pinged them to stand by in case token cache warms slowly.

Kevin: OK — final plan: T-15 lower TTL to 60s, T-10 confirm TTL, T0 start 5% for 30m, run smoke checks, advance as long as no alerts. Abort criteria: p95 > 2x baseline, error rate > 0.5% absolute increase, any 5xx spike > 10rps.

Ana: I'll post baseline numbers in the channel by EOD.

Jordana: Thanks all. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can attend the window. Will post the final confirmation ~1h before.

Kevin: :thumbsup:
Ana: :thumbsup:
Li: :thumbsup:
Samir: :thumbsup:
